This document authors these schemas, all Planned (M1) and proposed for Configuration model registration (OQ-security-and-identity-2 and -3)
auth.basic config: no fields; reads `Authorization: Basic`, a malformed value is RZ-AUTH-002
auth.mtls config.caCertificate: required `SecretValue`, PEM bundle of client CAs, rotated by watch
auth.mtls config.subjects: optional `set`, each rule exactly one of `subject` (RFC 4514, exact) or `uriSan` (exact); empty admits any verified leaf; no match is RZ-AUTH-002
auth.mtls config.crl: optional `SecretValue`, PEM CRLs, watched; a listed serial is RZ-AUTH-004; past `nextUpdate` the last CRL stays enforced and the Node reports a degraded state
Consumer credentials.basic: `map` keyed by `username`; each entry holds `hash` and `iterations`
credentials.basic[].iterations: 600,000 to 1,000,000, default 600,000 (target); outside that range fails validation
Consumer credentials.certificates: `map` keyed by `name`; each entry exactly one of `subject` or `uriSan`
A leaf MUST carry the `clientAuth` extended key usage; a leaf matching no Consumer sets `auth` and leaves `consumer` null
A `username`, `subject` or `uriSan` declared by two Consumers fails validation
